map.输入价格变动前后价格与销量，计算需求价格弹性（PED），评估涨价或降价对销量与收: Enter prices and volumes before and after a price change to compute the price elasticity of demand (PED), assessing how a price rise or cut affects volume and revenue, to guide pricing strategy.
map.涨价前量化销量会掉多少，判断总收入涨跌。: Before a price increase, quantify how much volume will drop to judge whether total revenue rises or falls.
map.按 |E| 分完全无弹性/缺乏/单位/富有弹性。: Classify by |E| as perfectly inelastic / inelastic / unit / elastic.
map.对比促销前后收入变化选策略。: Compare revenue before and after a promotion to pick a strategy.
map.：价格 100→110（+10%），销量 1000→850（−15%）→ E=−: : price 100 -> 110 (+10%), volume 1000 -> 850 (-15%) -> E = -15%/+10% = -1.5, |E| > 1 meaning elastic; original revenue 100,000, new revenue 93,500, so the price rise earns less.
map.：价格 +10%、销量仅 −3% → E=−0.3，原收入 100000、新收入: : price +10% with volume falling only -3% -> E = -0.3; original revenue 100,000, new revenue 113,300, so this necessity good suits a price rise.
map.正常，价量反向；看绝对值。|E|<1 缺弹性可提价增收，|E|>1 富有弹性提价: Normal, price and volume move inversely; look at the absolute value. |E| < 1 means inelastic, so raising price raises revenue; |E| > 1 means elastic, so raising price tends to lose revenue.
map.会。短期刚性、长期可替代则变弹；促销期与平时也不同，宜分场景测算。: Yes. Demand is rigid short term but substitutable long term, so elasticity changes; promotional and normal periods differ too, so measure per scenario.
